# LLMCSS full specification for AI agents (llms-full.txt)

## 1. What LLMCSS is

LLMCSS is a pure native CSS UI framework for AI coding agents and human developers. One prefix: `ai-*`.
One stylesheet ships 1176 classes and 82 `--ai-*` tokens under `@layer reset, tokens, base, components, utilities`.
Generated JSON manifests state exactly which classes, tokens, states and components exist, so an agent never has to guess.
106 components (93 free, 13 Pro), 18 wireframe section templates and 4 page blueprints are addressable by id.
An optional one-file runtime adds modal, drawer, dropdown, accordion, tabs, toast and command palette behavior. Everything else is CSS only.

## 2. Install

The stylesheet is the whole install for every CSS-only component. Add the runtime tag only if the page uses interactive components.

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://llmcss.io/llmcss.css" />
<script src="https://llmcss.io/llmcss.js" defer></script>
```

Pin a release with the versioned path. Versioned files are served immutable; the unversioned paths always track the latest release.

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://llmcss.io/v/0.2.0/llmcss.css" />
<script src="https://llmcss.io/v/0.2.0/llmcss.js" defer></script>
```

From npm: `npm install llmcss`, then import `llmcss/llmcss.css` and, if needed, `llmcss/llmcss.js`.

## 3. Machine-readable manifests

Generated from the CSS and the registry at build time, so they cannot drift from the shipped stylesheet.

classes.json, https://llmcss.io/classes.json: every `ai-*` class that exists. If a class is not in this file, it does not exist.

```json
{ "version": "0.1.0", "generatedAt": "2026-09-12T04:28:32.876Z",
  "note": "variants lists the responsive (sm 640px, md 768px, lg 1024px, xl 1280px) and container-query (cq) prefixes that exist for the class, written as ai-md:<class>.",
  "stats": { "total": 1176, "families": { "spacing": 238, "interaction": 102, "sizing": 94, "grid": 87 } },
  "classes": [ { "class": "ai-gap-4", "family": "spacing", "file": "utilities.css", "variants": ["cq", "md", "sm"] } ] }
```

tokens.json, https://llmcss.io/tokens.json: every `--ai-*` custom property with its value per context (`light`, `dark`, each skin, `<skin>:dark`, `focus:<preset>`). A context key is absent when that context does not override the token.

```json
{ "stats": { "total": 82 },
  "tokens": [ { "token": "--ai-accent",
    "values": { "light": "#2563eb", "dark": "#3b82f6", "obsidian": "#18181b", "obsidian:dark": "#f5f5f5",
                "fintech": "#0f766e", "fintech:dark": "#2dd4bf" } } ] }
```

states.json, https://llmcss.io/states.json: every `is-*` state class with the components that use it, and every `data-ai-*` attribute with allowed values and whether the author or the runtime applies it.

```json
{ "states": [ { "class": "is-open",
    "usedBy": ["ai-accordion-item", "ai-drawer", "ai-dropdown", "ai-modal", "ai-popover"] } ],
  "attributes": [ { "attribute": "data-ai-toggle", "values": ["modal", "drawer", "dropdown", "accordion"],
    "on": "button", "appliedBy": "author", "purpose": "Runtime toggle. modal and drawer need data-ai-target." } ] }
```

registry.json, https://llmcss.io/registry.json: the component catalog. Free entries carry their full `html`; Pro entries are locked.

```json
{ "stats": { "total": 106, "free": 93, "pro": 13,
    "categories": { "primitive": 48, "marketing": 21, "application": 34, "ecommerce": 3 } },
  "components": [ { "id": "btn-variants", "name": "Button Variants", "description": "High-craft buttons.",
    "category": "primitive", "tier": "free", "tags": ["button", "cta"], "html": "<div class=\"ai-flex\">...</div>" } ] }
```

r/{id}.json, https://llmcss.io/r/btn-variants.json: one free component, the same object as its `registry.json` entry. It exists for the 93 free ids only.

```json
{ "id": "btn-variants", "name": "Button Variants", "description": "High-craft buttons.",
  "category": "primitive", "tier": "free", "tags": ["button", "cta"],
  "html": "<div class=\"ai-flex ai-flex-wrap ai-gap-3\">...</div>" }
```

r/pro/{id}.json, https://llmcss.io/r/pro/tool-trace.json: Pro markup, gated by a subscription token sent as a Bearer header. On success the body has the same shape as a free entry plus an optional `css` string to link after `llmcss.css`.

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer llmcss_live_..." https://llmcss.io/r/pro/tool-trace.json
```

templates.json, https://llmcss.io/templates.json: the 18 wireframe section templates with placement guidance, and the 4 page blueprints that stack them.

```json
{ "stats": { "totalTemplates": 18, "totalBlueprints": 4, "sections": { "header": 3, "hero": 3, "features": 3 } },
  "wireframeTemplates": [ { "id": "wireframe-nav-minimal", "name": "Minimal Navigation Bar", "section": "header",
    "tier": "free", "tags": ["nav"], "placement": "Top of Page (Above Fold)",
    "guidance": { "placement": "...", "bestUsedFor": "...", "avoidWhen": "...", "pairsWith": ["wireframe-hero-split"] },
    "html": "<header class=\"ai-navbar\" role=\"banner\">...</header>" } ],
  "pageBlueprints": [ { "id": "saas-landing", "name": "High-Conversion SaaS Landing Page", "description": "...",
    "recommendedFor": "...", "sections": ["wireframe-nav-minimal", "wireframe-hero-split"] } ] }
```

The MCP tools `list_classes`, `list_tokens` and `list_states` return the same data without a network fetch.

## 4. Runtime contract

### What needs the script

Load `https://llmcss.io/llmcss.js` once per page when the markup uses any of:

- `data-ai-toggle="modal|drawer|dropdown|accordion"`
- `data-ai-dismiss="modal|drawer|toast"`
- `data-ai-tab="#panel-id"`
- the custom elements `<ai-modal> <ai-drawer> <ai-dropdown> <ai-accordion> <ai-tabs> <ai-toast> <ai-command-palette>`

Without the script every component still renders and themes correctly. Only toggling needs JavaScript, or a native `<details class="ai-collapse">`.

### DOM nesting rules

- Modal: the toggle carries `data-ai-target="#id"`. The target `.ai-modal` contains an `.ai-modal-backdrop` and an `.ai-modal-box`. Focus moves to the box.
- Drawer: same pattern with `.ai-drawer`, `.ai-drawer-backdrop` and `.ai-drawer-panel`.
- Dropdown: the toggle has `data-ai-toggle="dropdown"` and sits inside `.ai-dropdown` next to `.ai-dropdown-menu`. No target attribute.
- Accordion: the toggle has `data-ai-toggle="accordion"` and sits inside `.ai-accordion-item` above `.ai-accordion-content`.
- Tabs: `button.ai-tab[data-ai-tab="#panel-id"]` inside `.ai-tabs-list` inside `.ai-tabs`; panels are `.ai-tab-panel` with matching ids in the same `.ai-tabs`.
- Toast: `.ai-toast` inside `.ai-toast-container`; a close button with `data-ai-dismiss="toast"` removes the toast node.

### State vocabulary

- Open state is written twice: the `open` attribute and the `.is-open` class. They are interchangeable and the runtime sets and clears both. Author either one in static markup.
- Tabs use `.is-active` on the tab and its panel, plus `aria-selected="true"` on the tab. The runtime also manages `tabindex` for roving focus.
- `aria-expanded` on a trigger is owned by the runtime. `aria-invalid="true"` on `.ai-input`, `.ai-textarea` or `.ai-select` is owned by the author.

### Guarantees

For modal, drawer and command palette the runtime guarantees:

- Focus moves into the panel on open and returns to the trigger on close.
- Tab is trapped inside the topmost overlay.
- Every sibling of the overlay in `<body>` is set `inert` while it is open.
- Escape closes only the topmost overlay, then falls through to open dropdowns.
- `aria-expanded` stays in sync on every trigger pointing at the overlay.
- Arrow keys, Home and End move between tabs and activate them.
- `.ai-drawer-no-lock` or `.ai-modeless` opts an overlay out of the inert behavior, for a panel the user works alongside.
- `window.LLMCSS.open(el)` and `window.LLMCSS.close(el)` drive the same code path from your own script.

### Pro contract

- A Pro component's `registry.json` entry has `tier: "pro"`, `locked: true` and `html: null`. Its `previewHtml` is an upsell card, not the component.
- `npx llmcss add <pro-id>` with no stored token prints a subscribe and login hint, then exits 1.
- After `npx llmcss login <token>` the CLI fetches `GET /r/pro/{id}.json` with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
- The MCP tool `get_component_markup` on a Pro id without a token returns `{ locked: true, html: null, message }`.
- Never write Pro markup from memory. It is not in the public catalog and any guess will be wrong.

## 5. Page skeleton

Theme and skin go on `<html>`; the runtime tag goes last.

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en" data-ai-theme="light" data-ai-skin="executive">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
    <title>Fleet console</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://llmcss.io/llmcss.css" />
  </head>
  <body>
    <div class="ai-container">
      <section class="ai-section">
        <h1 class="ai-section-title">Fleet console</h1>
        <p class="ai-section-lead">Every deployed agent, its current task, and the queue behind it.</p>
        <div class="ai-grid ai-grid-cols-1 ai-md:grid-cols-3 ai-gap-6 ai-mt-8">
          <article class="ai-card">
            <div class="ai-card-header">
              <h2 class="ai-card-title">Throughput</h2>
              <p class="ai-card-description">Requests completed in the last hour.</p>
            </div>
            <div class="ai-card-body"><p class="ai-kpi-value">18,402</p></div>
            <div class="ai-card-footer">
              <button class="ai-btn ai-btn-primary ai-btn-sm">Export telemetry</button>
            </div>
          </article>
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
    <script src="https://llmcss.io/llmcss.js" defer></script>
  </body>
</html>
```

## 6. Worked examples

Every class below is in classes.json. These are body fragments; drop them inside the skeleton above.

### 6.1 Form with an error state

`aria-invalid="true"` drives the error styling. `.ai-form-hint` is the neutral hint, `.ai-form-error` the message.

```html
<form class="ai-max-w-md">
  <div class="ai-form-group">
    <label class="ai-form-label is-required" for="workspace">Workspace name</label>
    <input class="ai-input" id="workspace" name="workspace" type="text" value="fleet-eu-west" />
    <p class="ai-form-hint">Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Used in the workspace URL.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="ai-form-group">
    <label class="ai-form-label is-required" for="email">Billing email</label>
    <input class="ai-input" id="email" name="email" type="email" value="ops@"
           aria-invalid="true" aria-describedby="email-error" />
    <p class="ai-form-error" id="email-error">Enter a complete address, for example ops@example.com.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="ai-form-group">
    <label class="ai-form-label" for="region">Primary region</label>
    <select class="ai-select" id="region" name="region">
      <option>eu-west-1</option>
      <option>us-east-1</option>
    </select>
    <p class="ai-form-hint">Data stays in this region. Changing it later triggers a migration.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="ai-flex ai-gap-3 ai-mt-6">
    <button class="ai-btn ai-btn-primary" type="submit">Create workspace</button>
    <button class="ai-btn ai-btn-ghost" type="button">Discard</button>
  </div>
</form>
```

### 6.2 Dashboard row with one dominant KPI

Law 8 in practice: `.ai-kpi-card.is-primary` anchors the row, and the supporting numbers sit in a table rather than in three more equal tiles.

```html
<section class="ai-section">
  <div class="ai-page-header">
    <h2 class="ai-section-title">Inference spend</h2>
    <p class="ai-page-header-meta">Rolling 30 days, all projects.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="ai-grid ai-grid-cols-1 ai-md:grid-cols-3 ai-gap-4">
    <div class="ai-kpi-card is-primary">
      <p class="ai-kpi-label">Total spend</p>
      <p class="ai-kpi-value">$412,860</p>
      <p class="ai-kpi-trend is-up">+12.4% vs previous 30 days</p>
    </div>
    <div class="ai-kpi-card">
      <p class="ai-kpi-label">Cost per 1k requests</p>
      <p class="ai-kpi-value">$0.94</p>
    </div>
    <div class="ai-kpi-card">
      <p class="ai-kpi-label">Cache hit rate</p>
      <p class="ai-kpi-value">71.2%</p>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="ai-table-container ai-mt-6">
    <table class="ai-table ai-table-hover">
      <thead>
        <tr><th scope="col">Project</th><th scope="col">Requests</th><th scope="col">Spend</th><th scope="col">Status</th></tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr><td>atlas-router</td><td class="ai-cell-num">4,210,883</td><td class="ai-cell-num">$188,204</td>
            <td><span class="ai-status-pip ai-status-pip-success"></span> Healthy</td></tr>
        <tr><td>ingest-worker</td><td class="ai-cell-num">2,904,117</td><td class="ai-cell-num">$121,455</td>
            <td><span class="ai-status-pip ai-status-pip-warning"></span> Throttled</td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
</section>
```

### 6.3 Modal with a trigger

The trigger points at the modal id. Backdrop and close button both dismiss. This example needs the runtime script.

```html
<button class="ai-btn ai-btn-danger" data-ai-toggle="modal" data-ai-target="#revoke-modal"
        aria-expanded="false">Revoke API key</button>

<div class="ai-modal" id="revoke-modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="revoke-title">
  <div class="ai-modal-backdrop" data-ai-dismiss="modal"></div>
  <div class="ai-modal-box">
    <div class="ai-modal-header">
      <h2 class="ai-modal-title" id="revoke-title">Revoke API key</h2>
      <button class="ai-modal-close" data-ai-dismiss="modal" aria-label="Close"></button>
    </div>
    <div class="ai-modal-body">
      <p>Key <code>sk_live_9f21</code> stops working immediately. Requests signed with it return 401.</p>
      <p class="ai-text-secondary ai-text-sm ai-mt-2">Four services still use this key. Rotate them first.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="ai-modal-footer">
      <button class="ai-btn ai-btn-outline" data-ai-dismiss="modal">Cancel</button>
      <button class="ai-btn ai-btn-danger">Revoke key</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

## 7. Tokens

Every value in `llmcss.css` is a `--ai-*` custom property. Override any of them on `:root` or on a container. Exact values per context are in tokens.json.

- Spacing scale, exact steps: `--ai-space-0` 0px, `-1` 0.25rem, `-2` 0.5rem, `-3` 0.75rem, `-4` 1rem, `-5` 1.25rem, `-6` 1.5rem, `-8` 2rem, `-10` 2.5rem, `-12` 3rem, `-16` 4rem, `-20` 5rem, `-24` 6rem, `-32` 8rem. There is no step 7, 9, 11, 14 or 18.
- Radii, exact values: `--ai-radius-none` 0, `--ai-radius-xs` 2px, `--ai-radius-sm` 3px, `--ai-radius-md` 4px, `--ai-radius-lg` 6px, `--ai-radius-xl` 8px, `--ai-radius-2xl` 12px, `--ai-radius-full` 9999px, plus `--ai-radius-base`, which skins reset.
- Surfaces: `--ai-bg`, `--ai-surface-0`, `--ai-surface-1`, `--ai-surface-2`, `--ai-surface-3`.
- Text: `--ai-text-primary`, `--ai-text-secondary`, `--ai-text-muted`, `--ai-text-inverted`.
- Borders: `--ai-border`, `--ai-border-subtle`, `--ai-border-strong`, `--ai-border-hover`.
- Action colors: `--ai-primary`, `--ai-primary-hover`, `--ai-accent`, `--ai-accent-hover`, `--ai-accent-subtle`, `--ai-accent-rgb`.
- On-color text, for text sitting on a filled action or status surface: `--ai-primary-text`, `--ai-accent-text`, `--ai-success-text`, `--ai-danger-text`. Use these instead of hard-coding white, which fails Law 7 in several dark skins.
- Status: `--ai-success`, `--ai-warning`, `--ai-danger`, `--ai-info`, each with a `-subtle` variant.
- Charts: `--ai-chart-1` through `--ai-chart-6`, color-blind safe.
- Shadows: `--ai-shadow-sm`, `--ai-shadow-md`, `--ai-shadow-lg`, `--ai-shadow-xl`, `--ai-shadow-inner`.
- Typography: `--ai-font-sans`, `--ai-font-serif`, `--ai-font-display`, `--ai-font-mono`.
- Motion: `--ai-duration-fast`, `--ai-duration-normal`, `--ai-duration-slow`, `--ai-ease-out`, `--ai-ease-in-out`, `--ai-ease-smooth`, `--ai-ease-spring`.
- Touch: `--ai-touch-min` 44px, enforced on buttons and controls under `@media (pointer: coarse)`.

Focus and tap: `--ai-focus-color` (accent at 65%), `--ai-focus-width` 2px and `--ai-focus-offset` 2px compose `--ai-focus-ring`. Presets on `<html>`: `data-ai-focus="neutral"` swaps the ring to the text color, `"thin"` is 1.5px with no offset, `"none"` removes it and leaves keyboard users without an indicator, so prefer neutral or thin. Rings render only on `:focus-visible`, never on tap or click. `--ai-tap-highlight` (transparent by default) controls the tint mobile browsers flash on tap.

Density: `data-ai-density="compact"` or `"spacious"` on `<html>` or any container rescales `--ai-space-2` through `--ai-space-8` for component padding. Absent means standard.

Per-instance tokens, set in a `style` attribute on the component itself rather than on `:root`: `--ai-card-padding` (default `--ai-space-6`), `--ai-modal-width` (default 32rem), `--ai-drawer-width` (default 26rem), `--ai-drawer-offset` (default 0px, use it to clear a fixed navbar on a top or bottom drawer), `--ai-sidebar-width` (default 16rem), `--ai-section-padding` (default `--ai-space-24`).

Dark mode activates only when you set `data-ai-theme="dark"`. LLMCSS contains no `prefers-color-scheme` query, so the OS setting does nothing by itself. To follow the OS, read the media query in your own script and set the attribute.

## 8. Skins

`data-ai-skin` on `<html>` or any container. Eight values exist.

- Full archetypes, which change surfaces, radius and type: `executive`, `fintech`, `obsidian`, `editorial`, `enterprise`. The first four have the archetype write-ups in section 12; `enterprise` is a fifth full skin without one.
- Accent-only skins, which change nothing but the accent ramp: `emerald`, `violet`, `rose`. Use one to recolor a default page without committing to an archetype.

## 9. Utilities

Only the classes in classes.json exist. Family sizes: spacing 238, interaction 102, sizing 94, grid 87, marketing 68, flex 65, typography 47, dashboard 44, utilities 44, extras 40, animations 33, application 29, badges 28, position 26, navigation 24, effects 22, borders 22, layout 16, inputs 15, cards 13, drawers 13, buttons 12, tables 12, toasts 12, base 12, modals 11, ecommerce 10, display 8, themes 7, dropdowns 6, alerts 6, accordions 5, tabs 5.

- Grid: `ai-grid`, `ai-grid-cols-1` to `ai-grid-cols-12`, `ai-col-span-*`, `ai-grid-auto-fit` with `ai-grid-min-xs|sm|md|lg`, `ai-subgrid-rows`, `ai-subgrid-cols`.
- Flex: `ai-flex`, `ai-flex-col`, `ai-flex-wrap`, `ai-items-*`, `ai-justify-*`, `ai-self-*`, `ai-order-*`, `ai-grow`, `ai-shrink`.
- Spacing: `ai-p-*`, `ai-px-*`, `ai-m-*`, `ai-mx-*`, `ai-gap-*` on the token scale above, plus negative margins `ai--m-1` to `ai--m-4` and logical mirrors `ai-ps-*`, `ai-ms-*`.
- Sizing: `ai-w-*` and `ai-h-*` on the same numeric scale, fractions such as `ai-w-1/2`, plus `ai-size-*`, `ai-max-w-xs` to `ai-max-w-6xl`, `ai-max-w-prose`.
- Typography: `ai-text-xs` to `ai-text-7xl`, `ai-font-light` to `ai-font-bold`, `ai-leading-*`, `ai-tracking-*`, `ai-truncate`, `ai-line-clamp-1|2|3`, `ai-text-balance`, `ai-text-pretty`.
- Position, effects, interaction: `ai-relative`, `ai-absolute`, `ai-sticky`, `ai-inset-0`, `ai-z-0` to `ai-z-50`, `ai-shadow-*`, `ai-opacity-*`, `ai-overflow-*`, `ai-transition`, `ai-cursor-*`, `ai-select-none`, `ai-sr-only`.

Responsive prefixes: exactly five exist, `ai-sm:` (640px), `ai-md:` (768px), `ai-lg:` (1024px), `ai-xl:` (1280px) and `ai-cq:` (container query, needs a `.ai-cq` ancestor). They are not generated for every class. Each classes.json entry lists the prefixes that exist for that class in its `variants` array, and nothing else resolves: `ai-gap-4` has `["cq", "md", "sm"]`, so `ai-md:gap-4` works while the `xl` form of that same class does not exist.

Variable escape hatches: eleven utilities read a local variable instead of a fixed value, for the cases the scale does not cover. Set the variable inline.

```html
<div class="ai-w-var" style="--ai-w: 37%;">Off-scale width</div>
<div class="ai-grid ai-grid-cols-var" style="--ai-cols: 2fr 1fr;">Asymmetric columns</div>
```

The full set: `ai-w-var` (`--ai-w`), `ai-h-var` (`--ai-h`), `ai-min-w-var` (`--ai-min-w`), `ai-max-w-var` (`--ai-max-w`), `ai-p-var` (`--ai-p`), `ai-m-var` (`--ai-m`), `ai-gap-var` (`--ai-gap`), `ai-grid-cols-var` (`--ai-cols`), `ai-transform-var` (`--ai-transform`), `ai-bg-var` (`--ai-bg-color`), `ai-text-var` (`--ai-text-color`).

## 10. CLI and MCP

CLI, `npx llmcss <command>`. Binaries are `llmcss` and `llmcss-mcp`, with `cssai` and `cssai-mcp` as aliases.

```
list                      List all components, free and Pro
search <query>            Search by keyword, tag, or alias
info <id>                 Print raw component metadata
add <id>                  Write component HTML into components/<category>/
templates                 List the 18 wireframe section templates
template get <id>         Print one section's HTML
template blueprints       List the 4 full-page blueprints
template blueprint <id>   Assemble and print a full page
harness [archetype]       Print the archetypes and the anti-slop laws
audit <file>              Run the anti-slop checks against a file
validate <file>           Flag non ai- and hallucinated classes
lint --fix <file>         Auto-migrate legacy classes to ai- equivalents
init                      Write llmcss.config.json
login <token>             Store a Pro license token
help                      Print this list
```

MCP, `npx llmcss-mcp`, a stdio JSON-RPC server. `cssai_get_harness` and `cssai_slop_audit` are aliases of the two `llmcss_` tools.

```
search_components         Search the catalog by keyword, tag, or category
get_component_markup      Return one component's HTML, or the locked payload for Pro
validate_markup           Check a snippet for hallucinated or unprefixed classes
list_classes              Every ai-* class, filterable by family or prefix
list_tokens               Every --ai-* token, filterable by group and context
list_states               Every is-* state class and data-ai-* attribute
llmcss_get_harness        The archetype tokens and the anti-slop laws
llmcss_slop_audit         Audit a snippet against the anti-slop laws
list_wireframe_templates  The section templates with placement guidance
get_wireframe_template    One section template's HTML and guidance
get_page_blueprint        One assembled multi-section page recipe
```

## 11. The eleven anti-slop laws

Generated from src/registry/laws.mjs. `npx llmcss audit <file>` and the MCP tool `llmcss_slop_audit` check markup against them.

[laws:start]
1. Never nest containers: Do not put a bordered card inside another bordered card. Nested boxes waste screen real estate and create dizzying visual layers. Instead: Use generous whitespace (`--ai-space-6`), subtle hairline rules (`<hr class="ai-divider">`), or distinct background shifts (`var(--ai-surface-1)`).
2. Never pulse static status pips: Never attach continuous breathing or pulsing animations (`@keyframes pulse`) to steady states like "System Normal", "Online", or "Completed". Flashing elements demand attention when nothing has changed. Instead: Render a calm, static jewel pip with `.ai-status-pip` and `box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(...)`. Reserve `.ai-status-pip.is-streaming` strictly for ongoing inference or active data transmission.
3. Never use colored left-stripe borders: Do not place thick 3px to 5px colored vertical stripes on the left edge of cards, toasts, or dialogs. This 2012-era alert tell makes every element scream for attention. Instead: Use a 1px uniform architectural border (`border: 1px solid var(--ai-border)`), accompanied by a subtle 6px status jewel pip or an inline icon.
4. Never use electric purple or cyan halos and radial glows: Avoid murky dark backgrounds flooded with saturated purple-to-blue gradients or zero-offset neon drop shadows. Instead: Build depth using multi-stop physical elevation with a slight vertical offset: `box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05), 0 8px 16px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);`.
5. Never stamp formulaic eyebrows above headlines: Avoid adding an uppercase monospace overline (`01 // FEATURES` or `OVERVIEW`) above every heading. When repeated everywhere, eyebrows become visual noise that delays reading the headline. Instead: Lead directly with a confident, well-typeset headline (`h1` or `h2`). If context is needed, fold it into the heading or the supporting sentence.
6. Never crush letter-spacing below -0.04em or justify body text: Do not apply extreme negative letter-spacing that makes characters collide, and never use `text-align: justify`, which causes distracting typographic rivers. Instead: Keep body text at tracking `0` with `line-height: 1.6`. Restrict negative tracking to large display headings (`-0.02em` to `-0.035em`).
7. Never place low-contrast gray text on colored backgrounds: Never render neutral `#71717a` gray text over an accent surface or a tinted banner. Instead: Ensure WCAG AA compliance (minimum 4.5:1 for body copy, 3:1 for large display). When the background is tinted, tint the secondary text from the same hue.
8. Never create flat, identical metric grids: Do not display 4 identical KPI cards with identical weights and icons. Instead: Establish clear hierarchy. Make the primary metric anchor dominant in size (`font-size: 2.5rem; font-weight: 700;`), with supporting secondary metrics grouped in tighter rows or tables below.
9. Never auto-scroll copy: Do not force readers to wait for auto-scrolling tickers or animated marquee loops to read supported integrations or technologies. Instead: Render a clean, static, responsive badge rail (`.ai-badge-neutral`) or a balanced grid that users can scan at their own speed.
10. Always theme native browser surfaces: An interface is incomplete if native browser affordances revert to un-themed system defaults. Instead: Verify text selection (`::selection`), caret color (`caret-color: var(--ai-accent)`), custom scrollbars (`scrollbar-color`), link underline offset (`text-underline-offset: 0.2em`), and tabular numerals (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`).
11. Never use square grid backgrounds: Avoid covering backgrounds in repeating 20px to 40px square grid lines, dot grids, or mesh graph paper patterns built from intersecting linear-gradient declarations. This is one of the most overused, robotic hallmarks of AI-generated template kits. Instead: Lead with clean, distraction-free solid surfaces (`var(--ai-surface-0)`, `var(--ai-bg)`, `var(--ai-surface-1)`) structured with subtle 1px hairline architectural borders (`var(--ai-border)`).
[laws:end]

## 12. Archetype token blocks

Pick one archetype per project rather than defaulting to generic dark SaaS styling. Setting `data-ai-skin` is enough; the blocks below are the same values, for pages that want to pin or fork them.

[archetypes:start]
Archetype A: Executive Slate, data-ai-skin="executive"
Vibe: High-density, disciplined engineering workspace, precision data tools.
Attributes: Cool slate grays, 4px architectural radius, razor-sharp 1px borders, tabular numerals.
```css
:root[data-ai-skin="executive"] { --ai-font-sans: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; --ai-font-display: 'Sora', 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; --ai-font-mono: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; --ai-radius-base: 4px; --ai-radius-md: 4px; --ai-radius-lg: 6px; --ai-accent: #2563eb; --ai-accent-rgb: 37, 99, 235; --ai-bg: #f8fafc; --ai-surface-0: #ffffff; --ai-surface-1: #f1f5f9; --ai-border: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08); --ai-border-strong: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.18); }
:root[data-ai-skin="executive"][data-ai-theme="dark"] { --ai-bg: #09090b; --ai-surface-0: #0f172a; --ai-surface-1: #1e293b; --ai-border: rgba(248, 250, 252, 0.08); --ai-border-strong: rgba(248, 250, 252, 0.18); }
```

Archetype B: Fintech Titanium, data-ai-skin="fintech"
Vibe: Regulated financial intelligence, institutional security, high clarity.
Attributes: Warm stone neutrals, 6px radius, emerald and teal accents, generous white space, high-legibility sans.
```css
:root[data-ai-skin="fintech"] { --ai-font-sans: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; --ai-font-display: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; --ai-radius-base: 6px; --ai-radius-md: 6px; --ai-radius-lg: 8px; --ai-accent: #0f766e; --ai-accent-rgb: 15, 118, 110; --ai-success: #059669; --ai-bg: #f8f8f6; --ai-surface-0: #ffffff; --ai-surface-1: #f3f3f0; --ai-border: rgba(28, 25, 23, 0.08); --ai-border-strong: rgba(28, 25, 23, 0.16); }
:root[data-ai-skin="fintech"][data-ai-theme="dark"] { --ai-bg: #0c0d0e; --ai-surface-0: #141618; --ai-surface-1: #1c1e22; --ai-border: rgba(245, 245, 244, 0.08); --ai-border-strong: rgba(245, 245, 244, 0.16); }
```

Archetype C: Obsidian Minimal, data-ai-skin="obsidian"
Vibe: Pure dark-mode minimalist console, brutalist restraint, developer-first.
Attributes: Pitch-black background (`#000000`), stark white accents (`#ffffff`), 0px to 2px sharp radii, monospace accents.
```css
:root[data-ai-skin="obsidian"] { --ai-font-display: 'Sora', sans-serif; --ai-font-sans: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; --ai-font-mono: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; --ai-radius-base: 2px; --ai-radius-md: 2px; --ai-radius-lg: 4px; --ai-accent: #ededed; --ai-accent-rgb: 237, 237, 237; --ai-bg: #000000; --ai-surface-0: #0a0a0a; --ai-surface-1: #141414; --ai-border: #27272a; --ai-border-strong: #3f3f46; }
```

Archetype D: Editorial Atelier, data-ai-skin="editorial"
Vibe: High-craft publication, thoughtful essay, luxury studio, timeless typography.
Attributes: Warm paper substrate, Newsreader serif display headlines, crisp hairline borders, asymmetric rhythm, zero bento card clutter.
```css
:root[data-ai-skin="editorial"] { --ai-font-serif: 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif; --ai-font-display: 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif; --ai-font-sans: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; --ai-radius-base: 3px; --ai-radius-md: 4px; --ai-radius-lg: 6px; --ai-accent: #8c4a27; --ai-accent-rgb: 140, 74, 39; --ai-bg: #faf8f5; --ai-surface-0: #ffffff; --ai-surface-1: #f4eee6; --ai-border: rgba(41, 37, 36, 0.1); --ai-border-strong: rgba(41, 37, 36, 0.2); }
:root[data-ai-skin="editorial"][data-ai-theme="dark"] { --ai-bg: #141210; --ai-surface-0: #1a1715; --ai-surface-1: #24201c; --ai-border: rgba(244, 238, 230, 0.08); --ai-border-strong: rgba(244, 238, 230, 0.18); }
```
[archetypes:end]
